long_biography.plain_text:
Nickel was the commodity around which Willem C. van 't Wout built an international trading network. A Rotterdam scrap dealer, he established a French nickel-trading company in the 1960s and developed commercial links with Cuba that lasted for decades. His Indiana Finance group subsequently handled shipping, machinery and consumer goods as well as metals.

Van 't Wout's Cuba operations involved licensed import-export companies with local staff and offices. The group also formed a finance company licensed by Cuba's central bank to support trade. Rotterdam recognised his contribution to commerce with the Van der Mandele medal.
